description: Pythia's open-source compliance policy (task-207): which third-party licenses may ship with Pythia, an Apache-2.0 product distributed as binaries. Checked by scripts/check-oss-compliance.mjs (Gradle :frontend:checkOssCompliance, part of ./gradlew build). Explained in docs/oss-compliance.md. A license in no category is unknown and FAILS: this is a closed allow-list.

allowed.Apache-2.0: Our own license; permissive. Binary redistribution needs the license text and any NOTICE carried along (attribution: task-208).
allowed.MIT: Permissive; binary redistribution needs only the copyright and permission notice (attribution: task-208).
allowed.MIT-0: Permissive without even an attribution requirement.
allowed.BSD-2-Clause: Permissive; binary redistribution needs the copyright notice and disclaimer (attribution: task-208).
allowed.BSD-3-Clause: Permissive; as BSD-2-Clause plus a no-endorsement clause we do not touch.
allowed.Zlib: Permissive; only forbids misrepresenting the origin, which we do not do.
allowed.CC0-1.0: Public-domain dedication with a permissive fallback license.
allowed.Unlicense: Public-domain dedication with a permissive fallback license.
allowed.BlueOak-1.0.0: Permissive; requires passing on the license terms (attribution: task-208).
allowed.UPL-1.0: Permissive (Universal Permissive License), compatible with Apache-2.0.
allowed.Python-2.0: Permissive (PSF license family); binary redistribution needs the license notice (attribution: task-208).

conditional.EPL-1.0: Weak copyleft per module: acceptable for an UNMODIFIED library shipped as its own jar. Its source is available upstream; if we ever modify it, the modified source must be published under EPL.
conditional.EPL-2.0: Weak copyleft per module: acceptable for an UNMODIFIED library shipped as its own jar. Its source is available upstream; if we ever modify it, the modified source must be published under EPL.
conditional.MPL-2.0: File-level copyleft: acceptable for UNMODIFIED files used as a separate component. Source is available upstream; modified MPL files would have to be published.
conditional.LGPL-2.1-only: Weak copyleft: acceptable for an UNMODIFIED library used as a separate, replaceable component (a jar or package, not copied into our code). Source is available upstream; users may replace the library.
conditional.LGPL-2.1-or-later: Weak copyleft: acceptable for an UNMODIFIED library used as a separate, replaceable component (a jar or package, not copied into our code). Source is available upstream; users may replace the library.
conditional.LGPL-3.0-only: Weak copyleft: acceptable for an UNMODIFIED library used as a separate, replaceable component (a jar or package, not copied into our code). Source is available upstream; users may replace the library.
conditional.LGPL-3.0-or-later: Weak copyleft: acceptable for an UNMODIFIED library used as a separate, replaceable component (a jar or package, not copied into our code). Source is available upstream; users may replace the library.
conditional.GPL-2.0-with-classpath-exception: Deprecated SPDX id of GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0. The Classpath exception permits linking an UNMODIFIED library into an independent program under any license. Source is available upstream.
Current SPDX spelling of GPL-2.0-with-classpath-exception; same obligation: only an UNMODIFIED library, linked, source available upstream. Listed so the modern form is not judged as plain GPL-2.0-only.
conditional.GPL-2.0-or-later WITH Classpath-exceptio: As GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0: only an UNMODIFIED library, linked, source available upstream.
conditional.CDDL-1.0: Weak copyleft per file: acceptable for an UNMODIFIED library shipped as its own jar. Source is available upstream; modified CDDL files would have to be published.
conditional.CDDL-1.1: Weak copyleft per file: acceptable for an UNMODIFIED library shipped as its own jar. Source is available upstream; modified CDDL files would have to be published.

forbidden.GPL-2.0-only: Strong copyleft: distributing Pythia with it would require licensing the combined work under GPL-2.0, incompatible with Apache-2.0.
forbidden.GPL-2.0-or-later: Strong copyleft: distributing Pythia with it would require licensing the combined work under the GPL.
forbidden.GPL-3.0-only: Strong copyleft: distributing Pythia with it would require licensing the combined work under GPL-3.0.
forbidden.GPL-3.0-or-later: Strong copyleft: distributing Pythia with it would require licensing the combined work under the GPL.
forbidden.AGPL-3.0-only: Network copyleft: even offering Pythia as a service would require publishing the combined work under AGPL-3.0.
forbidden.AGPL-3.0-or-later: Network copyleft: even offering Pythia as a service would require publishing the combined work under the AGPL.
forbidden.SSPL-1.0: Source-available, not open source: offering the software as a service requires publishing the whole service stack.
forbidden.BUSL-1.1: Source-available with usage restrictions until the change date; not an open-source license.
forbidden.CC-BY-NC-4.0: Non-commercial only; incompatible with Apache-2.0, which permits commercial use.
forbidden.CC-BY-SA-4.0: Share-alike copyleft not intended for software and one-way incompatible with Apache-2.0.

exceptions.license: Public Domain (the license NAME in the SBOM; not an SPDX id)
